acceptance: Red first: a leaf of a branch one commit past origin/main is under 1 MB and its bundle verifies
Red first: a tip that is in origin/main gives a leaf with the tip and no bundle, and the release goes on
A failed bundle step still keeps the tree and the branch
fix: Write `git bundle create <file> <tip> ^origin/main`. When `git rev-list --count origin/main..<tip>` is 0, record the tip in the leaf and write no bundle (git refuses an empty bundle). Keep the verify and list-heads checks.
summary: Plan docs/plans/cycle-recycle-and-gc-check-2026-11.md (PR #1585), decision D9, component X0. bundleVerified (go/internal/gc/salvage.go:85) and bundleBranch (go/internal/gc/branchsweep.go:115-125) bundle a ref with no negative base, so each bundle holds the full history (up to 1.1 GB). 254 leaves held 187 GB on 2026-11-20.
title: Salvage and branch-sweep bundles hold only the commits that origin/main does not hold
